description: This file defines an interface for work schedule-related operations within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin, including methods for setting employee number, retrieving shift length and start/end times, and checking for non-working days, half-days, holidays, and holiday half-days.

classes.name: WorkScheduleInterface
classes.description: An interface specifying methods related to an employee's work schedule within the OrangeHRM leave management context.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the schedule, accepting null or an integer value.

methods.name: getWorkShiftLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the work shift as a float, e.g., 8 or 8.25 hours.

methods.name: getWorkShiftStartEndTime
methods.description: Returns the start and end time of the work shift as a WorkShiftStartAndEndTime object.

methods.name: isNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Determines if a given day is a non-working day, considering full-day status.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a half-day.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a half-day holiday.
